content.definition: Financial reporting framework designed to meet needs of specific users (not general purpose like GAAP)

types.ocboa: Other Comprehensive Basis of Accounting (cash, tax, regulatory, contractual)
types.incomplete_presentation: GAAP-based but incomplete (e.g., balance sheet only, single financial statement)
types.special_purpose_frameworks: Frameworks for specific entities (governmental, not-for-profit special rules)

when_appropriate: Private companies (not required to use GAAP)
Specific contractual requirements (lender requires cash basis)

incomplete_gaap_presentations.definition: One or more financial statements prepared in accordance with GAAP, but not complete set
incomplete_gaap_presentations.when_used: Contractual agreements, regulatory filings, specific user needs
incomplete_gaap_presentations.disclosure: Must disclose incomplete presentation and basis of accounting (GAAP)

financial_statement_titles.gaap: Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Statement of Cash Flows, etc.
financial_statement_titles.special_purpose: Must use different titles that reflect basis
examples: Statement of Assets and Liabilities - Modified Cash Basis
Statement of Revenue and Expenses - Income Tax Basis
Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Assets - Regulatory Basis

gaap.pros: Comprehensive, comparable, accepted by lenders/investors, required for public companies

special_purpose.pros: Simpler, less costly, meets specific needs, flexible
special_purpose.cons: Less comparable, limited distribution, not acceptable for public companies

disclosure_requirements.differences_from_gaap: Explain how framework differs from GAAP (qualitative)
disclosure_requirements.purpose: State purpose of financial statements (if limited use)
disclosure_requirements.material_transactions: Disclose material transactions even if not typical for framework

audit_and_review.special_purpose_audit: Auditor can audit special purpose financial statements
audit_and_review.report_modifications: Audit report states framework used, may restrict distribution
audit_and_review.review_or_compilation: Can also perform review or compilation on special purpose statements

distribution_restrictions.general_use: GAAP financial statements for general use
distribution_restrictions.restricted_use: Special purpose statements may be restricted to specific parties (management, lender, regulator)
distribution_restrictions.audit_report: Auditor may add restricting paragraph if appropriate

examples_by_industry.construction: Percentage-of-completion or completed contract (now ASC 606 over time)
examples_by_industry.not_for_profit: FASB standards for NFPs (not GAAP but specific framework)

transition_from_special_purpose_to_gaap.if_going_public: Must convert to GAAP (restate prior periods)
transition_from_special_purpose_to_gaap.if_new_lender_requires: May need to prepare GAAP statements alongside special purpose
transition_from_special_purpose_to_gaap.cost_consideration: Maintaining both sets can be costly

going_concern_in_special_purpose.still_applies: Going concern assessment required regardless of framework

cpa_exam_tips: Special purpose frameworks: Designed for specific users, not general purpose
Types: OCBOA (cash, tax, regulatory, contractual), incomplete GAAP presentations
Financial statement titles must reflect basis (not use GAAP titles if not GAAP)
Disclose: Basis used, differences from GAAP, purpose of statements
Audit report: States framework, may restrict distribution
Appropriate for: Private companies, contractual requirements, regulatory compliance

key_points: Special purpose frameworks: For specific users/purposes (not general purpose GAAP)
Types: OCBOA, incomplete GAAP presentations, industry-specific frameworks
Financial statement titles must reflect framework (not GAAP titles)
Disclose: Basis, differences from GAAP, purpose
Audit report: Special purpose framework opinion, may restrict distribution
Appropriate for private companies, contractual/regulatory needs
